name: naturabridgeb-android
description: Android wrapper for NaturaBridgeB. Serves ../www through Capacitor 8 (target SDK 36). Kept separate from the root package so the iOS pipeline (Capacitor 6) is untouched.

scripts.apk: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.aab: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
